data.long_meaning: Aamil (عامل) is the Arabic ʿāmil, 'worker, doer, agent, one who acts', the active participle of ʿamila, 'to work, to do'. It is a well-attested name from the root ʿ-m-l, the root of ʿamal, 'action, deed'.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to work and action; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Active participle of Arabic ʿamila, 'to work, to do'; root of ʿamal, 'action'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamil total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aamil mean?
faq.a: Aamil means Worker; doer; one who acts (ʿāmil).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aamil?
What language does the name Aamil come from?
faq.a: Aamil is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aamil a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aamil is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aamil written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aamil is written عامل in Arabic and عامل in Urdu, and आमिल in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aamil?
faq.a: The root of Aamil is ع-م-ل (ʿ-m-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aamil?
faq.a: Active participle of Arabic ʿamila, 'to work, to do'; root of ʿamal, 'action'.

faq.q: Does Aamil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿāmil is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-m-l.
Aamil is the Arabic ʿāmil, meaning 'worker, doer, one who acts', from ʿamila, 'to work, to do'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aamil?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamil total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aamil?
faq.a: Aamil appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Amil, Aamal.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aamil?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aamil include Aamer, Aamad.

faq.q: Is Aamil related to the word ʿamal?
faq.a: Yes. Both come from the root ʿ-m-l: ʿamal means 'action, deed', and ʿāmil is 'the one who acts'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aamil used today?
faq.a: Aamil is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
